title: Ripple
description: Draw concentric rings around the center: peach (1.0, 0.8, 0.65) and indigo (0.15, 0.1, 0.45) bands that repeat every 0.25 of distance from the center. The canvas runs from -1 to 1. Use fract(length(uv) * 4.0), and switch bands where abs(fract(value) - 0.5) crosses 0.25, with a smoothstep from 0.24 to 0.26.
